title: Deep Focus for Students
author: Bookly (namuna dars)
tagline: Bildirishnomalar dunyosida diqqatni qanday jamlash mumkin.
intro: Premium namunasi: diqqatni mashq qilish, vaqtni bloklarga bo‘lish va eng samarali soatlaringizni to‘g‘ri ishlatish haqida qisqa dars.
learnPoints: Qiyin ishlarni qaysi soatlarga rejalashtirish kerak
attribution: Bookly jamoasi tomonidan yozilgan original namuna dars. Muayyan kitobning qisqacha mazmuni emas.

sentences.en: Attention is not a fixed talent; it is a skill you can train.
sentences.uz: Diqqat — tug‘ma iste’dod emas, uni mashq qilib rivojlantirsa bo‘ladigan ko‘nikmadir.

sentences.en: Every time you switch between tasks, your brain needs time to refocus.
sentences.uz: Har safar bir vazifadan boshqasiga o‘tganingizda, miyangizga diqqatni qayta jamlash uchun vaqt kerak bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: That is why studying with notifications on feels tiring and slow.
sentences.uz: Shuning uchun bildirishnomalar yoqiq holda o‘qish charchatadigan va sekin tuyuladi.

sentences.en: Choose one task and set a timer for twenty-five minutes.
sentences.uz: Bitta vazifani tanlang va taymerni yigirma besh daqiqaga qo‘ying.

sentences.en: During that time, do only that task and nothing else.
sentences.uz: Shu vaqt davomida faqat o‘sha vazifani bajaring, boshqa hech narsani emas.

sentences.en: When the timer ends, take a real break of five minutes.
sentences.uz: Taymer tugagach, besh daqiqalik haqiqiy tanaffus qiling.

sentences.en: A real break means standing up, drinking water or looking out of the window, not scrolling.
sentences.uz: Haqiqiy tanaffus — o‘rningizdan turish, suv ichish yoki derazadan qarash, lentani varaqlash emas.

sentences.en: Most people have a few hours each day when their mind is clearest.
sentences.uz: Ko‘pchilikda har kuni fikri eng tiniq bo‘ladigan bir necha soat bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: Use those hours for difficult work, such as solving problems or writing.
sentences.uz: Bu soatlarni masala yechish yoki yozish kabi qiyin ishlarga sarflang.

sentences.en: Save easy tasks, like organising files, for the times when you feel tired.
sentences.uz: Fayllarni tartiblash kabi oson ishlarni charchagan paytlaringizga qoldiring.

sentences.en: Focus grows with practice, just like a muscle.
sentences.uz: Diqqat ham xuddi mushak kabi mashq bilan kuchayadi.

vocab.definition: the act of focusing your mind on something
to change from one thing to another
vocab.example: Don't switch tabs while you study.

vocab.definition: a message that appears on your phone or computer
vocab.example: I turn off notifications before I study.
My mind is clearer in the morning.

vocab.definition: a part of the body that becomes stronger with exercise
vocab.example: Your memory works like a muscle.

questions.prompt: What happens every time you switch between tasks?
questions.promptUz: Vazifalar orasida o‘tganingizda nima sodir bo‘ladi?
options: Your brain needs time to refocus
optionsUz: Miyangizga qayta diqqat jamlash uchun vaqt kerak bo‘ladi
questions.explanationUz: Birinchi bo‘lim: har bir o‘tish diqqatni qayta jamlashni talab qiladi.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a real break?
questions.explanationUz: Ikkinchi bo‘lim: haqiqiy tanaffus — harakat qilish va dam olish, lentani varaqlash emas.

questions.prompt: When should you do difficult work?
options: During the hours when your mind is clearest
questions.explanationUz: Uchinchi bo‘lim: eng samarali soatlaringizni qiyin ishlarga ajrating.

takeaway.en: Tomorrow, protect one 25-minute block for your hardest task — phone in another room.
takeaway.uz: Ertaga eng qiyin vazifangiz uchun bitta 25 daqiqalik blok ajrating — telefon esa boshqa xonada tursin.
